questions.question: In low-power digital IC design, what is the primary operational mechanism and benefit of clock gating?
options: Disabling the clock signal to sequential elements and downstream logic when their values do not need to change, thereby reducing dynamic switching power
Selectively disconnecting the ground reference to reduce subthreshold leakage current during circuit idle states
Inserting delay buffers along clock distribution trees to eliminate race conditions and satisfy hold time constraints
Dynamically scaling down both the supply voltage and the clock frequency simultaneously to minimize active power during low workloads
Skewing clock arrivals to adjacent registers to prevent simultaneous peak current surges on the power grid

questions.question: In advanced semiconductor manufacturing and physical design (such as sub-2nm nodes), what is the primary motivation for implementing a Backside Power Delivery Network (BSPDN)?
options: It eliminates the need for chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) by removing all metal layers from the front of the wafer
It separates the power distribution network from frontside signal interconnects, mitigating routing congestion and significantly reducing resistive IR drop
It integrates microfluidic cooling channels directly onto the backside silicon to eliminate localized thermal hotspots
It replaces copper wires with direct-contact carbon nanotubes to achieve room-temperature superconductivity in power distribution
It allows PMOS and NMOS transistors to share the exact same physical lithography mask, halving standard cell footprint

questions.question: In computer architecture and memory hierarchy design, which statement best defines the principle of spatial locality?
options: A memory location accessed at a specific point in time is very likely to be referenced repeatedly in the immediate future
Physical registers within an execution core must be co-located next to the arithmetic units to minimize parasitic propagation delay
Accessing a particular memory address makes it highly probable that memory locations physically adjacent or nearby will be accessed soon thereafter
Data stored in faster on-chip caches can be accessed with lower latency than data stored across off-chip interconnects
Translation Lookaside Buffers must map virtual pages to contiguous physical page frames to prevent external fragmentation

questions.question: During the physical verification stage of an ASIC design flow, what is the primary objective of running a Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) check?
options: To verify that all polygon shapes, layer clearances, and trace widths adhere to the foundry's geometric design rules
To compute interconnect capacitances and resistances for back-annotating timing simulations using a SPEF file
To prove mathematically that the register-transfer level (RTL) code produces identical logic output to the gate-level netlist
To confirm that the electrical devices and interconnected net topology in the physical layout match the original schematic or synthesized netlist
To guarantee that static power dissipation does not exceed the target thermal design power (TDP) under worst-case corner conditions

questions.question: In multiprocessor cache coherence, how does the 'Owner' (O) state in the MOESI protocol function compared to the 'Modified' (M) and 'Shared' (S) states?
options: The cache line is clean, matches main memory, and is locked exclusively to one core to prevent eviction during atomic memory transactions
The cache line is clean and present in multiple caches, but only the owner is authorized to write to it without broadcasting an invalidation request
The cache line is invalidated locally and is currently being updated in background by another core via an active write-through operation
The cache line is dirty and held exclusively by a single cache, meaning no other core's cache can hold a valid copy of the block
The cache line is dirty and shared with other caches (who hold it in the Shared state), with the owner cache responsible for supplying data to requesters and writing back to main memory upon eviction
